*   Topic: A good morning routine.
    *   Length: About 120 words.
    *   Constraint: Answer directly.

    *   Wake up early/consistent time.
    *   Hydration (water).
    *   Movement (stretching/exercise).
    *   Mindfulness (meditation/journaling).
    *   Nutrition (healthy breakfast).
    *   Planning (to-do list).

    A great morning routine sets a positive tone for the entire day. Start by waking up at a consistent time to regulate your internal clock. Begin with a glass of water to rehydrate your body after sleep. Incorporate light movement, such as stretching or a short walk, to wake up your muscles and boost circulation. Spend a few minutes in mindfulness—whether through meditation or journaling—to clear your mind and focus your intentions. Follow this with a nutritious breakfast that provides sustained energy. Finally, review your goals for the day to create a clear roadmap. By prioritizing self-care and organization, you transition from sleep to productivity with a sense of calm and purpose.
